verse.text: Study this Book of Instruction continually. Meditate on it day and night so you will be sure to obey everything written in it. Only then will you prosper and succeed in all you do.

video.title: Transform Your Mind with God's Word: Joshua 1:8

reflection: A dad who wants his household to thrive first has to be a man who's in the Word himself - not just quoting it at the dinner table, but actually chewing on it day and night. Success as a husband and father isn't measured by how much you hustle, but by how deeply God's instructions shape your everyday decisions. Start small: one chapter before your kids wake up can reset the whole tone of your leadership at home.
